- Verified Revenue = Quantity × Price holds on every row (0 mismatches), so no recomputation was needed.
- No duplicate rows; Quantity and Price are within the rules' ranges; no missing values in Category or Revenue.

Not fixed (not relevant to this question): Region has 2 missing values and 2 misspellings ("Suoth", "Nort"), and Date has a few non-ISO values — these don't affect the category revenue totals.
